items.text: Greetings, Hell Punishers!

First and foremost, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your incredible support since the launch of Heretic's Fork. Your feedback has been extremely appreciated, and we're committed to delivering the best experience.
With the Synergy Update, Here are some concerns we are addressing in this update:

🏗️ Lack of Build Variety We heard you! Currently, the path to victory often involves funneling one structure type. In this update, we're introducing new cards that reward creativity and diverse strategies. And trust us, there's more to come, more details below!

🎲 Reducing Initial RNG Tired of relying on the luck of the draw? Now you can take matters into your own hands. With the Synergy Update, you can choose up to two starting structures, giving you more control over your initial hand. No more endless restarts to get the perfect start!

items.text: Hi everyone!
Another adjustment to the gameplay to experiment with.
* All card upgrades are free.
* Reduced the fire rate of the "tank" heretic that shoots little sinners.
One of the drawbacks that came with the removal of the card storage mechanic was the following:

With the storage mechanic, when the player upgraded a card (for a cost) then they might not be able to use the card right away, but that didn't matter to the player too much because they could simply store it and use it during the next round after their power charges replenish.

After the removal of the storage mechanic, players would upgrade a card, not be able to use it right way because of insufficient power charges but also couldn't store it until the next round, so they would have to discard it and wait until it comes back in a reshuffle (if they survive that long). This was frustrating.

Having all card upgrade free should remove this frustration as the player will always be able to use a card right after upgrading it (presuming they are upgrading before using any other cards, as most players do).
This also helps with the general power scaling of the player and help them feel more powerful as they are able to use more cards earlier in the run, avoiding that first-stage difficulty spike.
Let me know what you think,
-Stevis
Hotfix 0.0.40
* Reduced the Health of all enemies by 50%
* Repenters Damage (50 to 25)
In the previous update (0.0.39) we disabled card storage in the sacrifice area.
The full game is currently in development and we are using this opportunity to experiment with gameplay changes, this means that the player experience might change from update to update.

This doesn't mean that the card storage functionality is gone forever, It may return either in its previous form, or as a character ability. We are just experimenting to see how the game feels without it.

Personally, I'm excited to hear what you think about the change. There are many reasons why we are trialing it, but I'm hesitant to list them here because I don't want to create a bias towards or against the change.
One thing that is obvious is that it makes the game harder, that's not the intention of the change so we have reduced the enemy HP to hopefully mitigate that aspect.
Please let us know what you think of the game without the storage mechanic in play. Your feedback is really appreciated.
The best place to give direct feedback and have a discussion about the change is in the discord. (I'm in there all day and try to be as active as a solo developer can be.)
Stevie

releases.displayName: Huge Announcement, A Challenging Update and more…

items.text: 🔥 Heretics!🔥

We are writing this message to express our deep gratitude for your extreme loyalty and eternal support. You have been by our side, embracing the darkness and enjoying the wicked pleasures of Heretic's Fork. Your actions have made a lasting impact on us, and we’re extremely grateful to have such a community as you, because of you, we’re once again in the New & Trending Page!

But don't worry, there's more to come! A big update is coming that will bring significant changes to our beloved software. This will reshape everything, bringing in a whole new experience. Get ready, because things are about to change drastically going forward. Our demons have been working hard to improve your sinful journey.

We want to also express our deepest gratitude to each one of you who has taken the time to share your thoughts and experiences with us. Your reviews, feedback, and comments, whether on Steam, Here in the feedback channels, or Twitter have been carefully noted and taking into extreme consideration. It is through your input that we have made this update for Heretic's Fork Demo and Probation. Your voices have shaped the evolution of this game in this genre, and we are forever grateful for your passion and continuous support.
Now let’s get into the technical stuff!
Sacrifice area no longer stores cards
Improved tower target acquisition
TAB to swap between item and card view (& added to controls menu)
New Occams laser tracks
Removed old tracks
Actives are now unique (one time use) (Spamming the same actives was OP on most of them.)
Added a card that increases recharge rate of all actives (3 tiers)
When upgrading cards or grabbing multiple cards from the collection, there should no longer be duplicates appearing.
Demo and Prologue HP multiplier per stage (x2.75 – x2.4)
Demo and Prologue max enemy count multiplier (x10 – x14)
Duplicating Shiv has a 20% proc chance on crit.
Garrison Bomber spawn recharge (3s to 4s)
Increased damage tick rate of sunder tower (0.1-0.4)
Garrison Shooter recharge(10s to 15s)
Garrison Sniper recharge (15s to 18s)
Garrison Repenters base AOE (50-70)
Hellfire Active damage (5-10)
Holy Beam Active damage (100-200)
Slap Damage (? → 200)
Guns of God attack delay (0.25s – 0.5s)
Sniper Garrison range (300 – 600)
Sniper Garrison speed (2 – 6)
Sniper Garrison DMG (2 – 3)
Sniper Garrison shoot delay (2s – 6s)
Repenter movement speed (1 – 2)
Frankie Fast Hand cost (2 – 3)
Hellfire Damage (20/30/50 – 10/20/30)
Reduced quality of Rainbow card (allows getting it earlier to run, so it can be built towards better.)
Added a new tier of Delivers of Pain and changed stat distribution to 10/15/20
Added a new tier of Persistence and changed stat distribution to 10/15/20
Added a new tier of Blessed Sight and changed stat distribution to 10/15/20
Added a new tier of Subordinates and changed stat distribution to 10/20/30
Added a new tier of Swift Vengeance and changed stat distribution to 10/15/20
Added a new tier of Frankie Fast Hands and changed stat distribution to 10/15/20
Added a new tier of Unholy Crit and changed stat distribution to 3/6/9
Added a new tier of Hemorrhage and changed stat distribution to 20/30/40
Added a new tier of Punish and changed stat distribution to 10/15/20
Added a new tier of Divine Sight and changed stat distribution to 10/15/20
Added a new tier of Fueled by Light and changed stat distribution to 10/15/20
Added two new tiers of Invigaron and changed stat distribution to 10/20/30
Fixed crash that sometimes occurs when combining 2 Judgement towers
Hellfire rock text highlighted properly
The amount of shield is also displayed in the HP value on screen, and changes color if part of it is shield.
Arrow appears on the line when placing or upgrading towers
Fixed cost of combining multiple legendaries.
In the meantime, let the fires of anticipation shine bright within your souls. The hellish experience is soon to be revealed upon you.
Sincerely, ❤️
Heretic’s Fork Team.
